entities.name: Danitha Capashen

events.summary: Aron leads the Benalish delegation at the Oyster Bay peace summit with Keld.
events.quote: he led the Benalish delegation at the peace summit at Oyster Bay

events.summary: Karn and Teferi reveal the Phyrexian threat and Benalish knights are exposed as sleeper agents.
events.quote: several of the Benalish knights were revealed as Phyrexian sleeper agents

events.summary: Sleeper agents carry Aron off with Ajani in pursuit; Ertai oversees his compleation.
events.quote: His compleation was personally overseen by Ertai

events.summary: Aron is eventually killed by his daughter Danitha.
